measurementBasis: Easee wall-energy delta from immutable session baseline divided by user-confirmed Tesla SOC delta
notes: Tesla SOC is not available automatically in Homey.
Start SOC comes from the user's deadline command or a user-confirmed SOC boundary; end SOC must be confirmed by the user from the Tesla app.
Operational factor remains fixed at 0.59 kWh/% during the five-session calibration watch; interim observations do not change it.
Five valid sessions are required before reporting average, median, range and a recommended wall-kWh/% calibration.
Charging losses are not added separately; the empirical wall-kWh/% factor already includes them implicitly.
